question: What should the v1 scope be for the root minihome redesign, especially around reusing the category/subcategory modules from https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/6798 versus building root-page-specific sections?
rationale: The request is valid but crosses design, SEO copy, search/catalog embedding, responsive behavior, and ranking/interlinking semantics, which need ecommerce product direction before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a planned CategoryHub redesign
options.body: Implement the root minihome redesign as a dedicated ecommerce PR, reusing shared search/filter and highlight primitives while defining root-specific copy and QA criteria.

options.title: Ship a narrower v1
options.body: Limit v1 to hero search, benefit banner, and catalog embedding, then track offers and interlinking as a follow-up.

options.title: Defer the minihomes
options.body: Leave the root minihomes unchanged for now and rely on the already-shipped category/subcategory page redesign.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a planned CategoryHub redesign
recommendation.body: Implement the root minihome redesign as a dedicated ecommerce PR, reusing shared search/filter and highlight primitives while defining root-specific copy and QA criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest shipped category-layout and interlinking implementation, making them the best code-history owner for scoping reuse versus new minihome modules.
